dedupe_keys.name: electricity demand solar and wind generation data september 2021 june 2025 of india at 1 hour interval

description: Electricity Demand, Solar and Wind Generation Data (September 2021- June 2025) of India at 1-hour interval is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Debanjan Mukherjee, Karuna Kalita (Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati). The data is provided by North-Eastern Regional Load Despatch Centre, Grid-India under the Ministry of Power, Government of India and consists of PMU-electricity demand, solar and wind generation data of all the combined five regional grid networks of India at the 1-hour interval between the period of September 2021 to December 2023. Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
